reference.reason: MTG-394 moves search and step digests on purpose: the automatic payer spends the most specific mana first, and mana made during a payment commits to the cost. The worst search reply moved to a different position (seed 1, decision 36) with one more legal choice and 28.5% more playout steps; per-step cost rose about 6.5% (local measurement on an M4 Max). Accepted.
